}}'''Fuling''' is an NPC that first appears in {{Quest|Immortal Blaze}}. She can later be seen near [[Burrata Bakery]] in [[Whisperwind Haven]], [[Rinascita]].
==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Idle)
:'''[[Wuli]]:''' Fuling, check out this book.
:'''Fuling:''' Fascinating...
----
;(Talk to Fuling)
:'''Fuling:''' Hi {{Rover}}, it's been a while.
:{{DIcon}} Isn't it Fuling and Wuli?
:{{DIcon}} Hello! What brings you two here?
:{{DIcon}} How are you holding up?
:'''Fuling:''' Thanks to you and Changli, I'm feeling much better now. I can even walk around a bit.
:'''Fuling:''' And I still want to explore more places and see different views.
:'''Wuli:''' And I will never let her do that alone.
:'''Wuli:''' Rinascita has always been on our list. Fuling talked about painting the sunset in [[Ragunna City]] and visiting the Salotto Open Air Gallery.
:'''Fuling:''' But I'm still not fit enough to walk a long way, so I was thinking maybe I could enjoy the scenery through pictures and paintings.
:'''Fuling:''' As we planned for it, we found some books scattered around Ragunna. But it's impossible for us to find them all, which is a bit of a letdown...
:{{DIcon}} I've got some books here.
:{{DIcon}} I can help you.
:'''Fuling:''' Well, we'd be immensely grateful! If you come across any illegible pages, feel free to show them to me.
:'''Fuling:''' I've studied the language of Rinascita before, so I can help interpret them.
:'''Wuli:''' Can't wait to hear your update, {{Rover}}. We'll have a reward ready while you search.
{{Dialogue End}}
